description: This source file provides a REST client API for interacting with a todo backend service. It offers functions to list, create, update, and delete tasks, handling HTTP requests and response normalization. The file includes internal helper functions for URL building and response processing.

methods.name: createTodoApiClient(apiBase)
methods.description: Factory function that creates an API client object with methods to interact with the todo backend.

methods.name: listTasks
methods.description: Fetches the list of tasks from the backend and returns normalized task objects.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Sends a request to create a new task with the provided payload, returning the created task.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by 'id' with the given payload.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by 'id' from the backend.
